title: Glowing drum
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow effects -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow circle -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="38" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa33" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.3" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Drum body - main cylinder -->
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="56" height="36" rx="4" fill="#e8a020"/>
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="56" height="36" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#f5c842" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Drum top ellipse -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="28" ry="12" fill="#f5d060"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="28" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffe680" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="22" ry="9" fill="#fff0a0"/>

  <!-- Drum bottom ellipse (slightly visible) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="28" ry="12" fill="#d8901a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="28" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#f0b830" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Drum side details - vertical lines -->
  <line x1="30" y1="42" x2="30" y2="70" stroke="#f0b830" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="44" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#f0b830" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="42" x2="70" y2="70" stroke="#f0b830" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Drum rim top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="28" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- Drum rim bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="28" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Tension rods -->
  <rect x="28" y="40" width="3" height="32" rx="1" fill="#ffdd77"/>
  <rect x="48" y="41" width="3" height="34" rx="1" fill="#ffdd77"/>
  <rect x="68" y="40" width="3" height="32" rx="1" fill="#ffdd77"/>

  <!-- Drumsticks -->
  <line x1="62" y1="18" x2="52" y2="36" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#ffd700"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="16" x2="48" y2="34" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#ffd700"/>

  <!-- Sparkles/glow particles -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="30" r="2" fill="#ffee55" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#ffee55" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="60" r="1.8" fill="#ffdd44" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="62" r="2" fill="#ffdd44" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#fff0a0"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="15" r="1.8" fill="#fff0a0"/>

  <!-- Musical notes -->
  <g fill="#ffdd55" filter="url(#glow)">
    <circle cx="15" cy="80" r="2.5"/>
    <line x1="17.5" y1="80" x2="17.5" y2="70" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="17.5" y1="70" x2="22" y2="71" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#ffdd55" filter="url(#glow)">
    <circle cx="84" cy="78" r="2"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="78" x2="86" y2="70" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="70" x2="90" y2="71" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
